name: What are the main stages of the kitchen remodeling process?

mainEntity.name: What are the main stages of the kitchen remodeling process?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen remodel begins with an initial consultation, site measurements, and conceptual design planning. Once you approve the layout and finalize material selections, orders are placed for long-lead items. Construction starts with demolition and progress through structural framing, plumbing, mechanical, and electrical rough-ins. After passing rough inspections, the crew installs drywall, flooring, cabinets, countertops, and backsplashes. The project wraps up with appliance installations, plumbing trim, final inspections, and a comprehensive punch-list walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process moves from design and permitting to demolition, rough-in trades, drywall, cabinet and counter installation, finish trim, and final inspections.
